request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER

layers.text: Change only two colours. His skin (face, ears, chest, belly, arms, hands, legs, feet) becomes a deeper, somewhat darker, true goblin green like moss, with a darker green shadow; not yellow, not black. His leather cap, crossed straps and loincloth become a browner, duller orange-brown saddle leather, shaded dark brown, not bright orange and not red. Keep everything else exactly the same: belt, wrist bands, dagger, eyes, teeth, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
